notes: Side by side: the marking screen can keep a second pane beside the paper. Tabs choose what it shows: the student’s video, their notes page, another file, or the rubric with what each score means. A student with a video and a notes page opens this way without being asked. Press B, or Side by side above the paper.
A click on your assistant’s name in the sidebar lists the others too. Pick one and it opens and becomes the one in use, with its own link. Settings, Working with AI chooses which are listed.
